shots.caption: A real question, answered with clause-level citations: the class C load-cell MPE, with the SOURCES panel naming publication, edition, and clause.
The worked-example certificate R60/2021-A-EX1-26.01: ACTIVE, the full document with its classification table, revision history, and the public-register verify pointer.
The public verification path: the certificate number checked against the public BIML register (B 18:2025 §15.8), no sign-in, with the W3C Status List revocation and suspension checks.
The mapping lens, honest about the current model: no mapping profiles declared yet.
The demo login page: the one-click demo accounts, the shared demo password, and the guided-demo entry.
The applicant portal after the one-click sign-in: ACME's five applications and three certificates.
One application opened: XX-ACME-2026-0001, ACCEPTED, with the link into the evaluation project.
The Issuing Authority console: the review queue, the twelve type-evaluation projects, the dispatch and issuance work.
The Test Laboratory workbench: the dispatch inbox and the ANR test-capability declaration.
The BIML console: the registration inbox and the recently registered worked-example certificate.
The guided demo's presenter script: the full certification flow, step 1 of 24, from the login page.
The estate sign-in: GitHub, Google, passkey, or password, and the Request an account link.
The join flow: full name, work email, and the organization selector fed by the live OIML-CS participants register, labeled by kind.
The OpenID discovery document every relying party in the estate resolves sign-in through.
All twelve probe rows operational: identity, the platform instances, the AI service, and the public surfaces, each with its measured uptime and p95.
Objectives vs reality: the declared availability and latency objectives next to the measured numbers, never rounded up.
The incident record: human-written, after the fact. When nothing has broken, it says so.
The off-corpus posture: a question the OIML library cannot answer gets a plain refusal, not an invention.
The service's own honest account: what happens between your question and the answer, including what it does not do.
The API reference: anonymous and member tiers with their daily question allowances, SSE streaming or complete JSON.
The model tree of OIML R 60 as data: 13 roles, 31 processes, with the read-only and computed-valid markers.
The code view: the same model as Primmel source — package, kind, editions, base URN, the modules it composes.
The diff lens: load a second version and the kernel's model-diff computes added, removed, changed, and moved per element.
The certificate preview: the instrument certificate rendered from the model itself.
The eleven datasets: the VIML and VIM edition series with the current editions marked, and the curated Complete Vocabulary.
Search across every edition at once: "calibration" hits grouped per dataset, each with its concept number.
One concept, one URL: calibration hierarchy (VIM 2.40) with its definition, relations, edition series, languages, and canonical URI.
The graph view: the term relations drawn as a navigable graph.
The production hub: the published SMART Recommendations with their requirement, test, and form counts.
The IA+TL pilot instance at nmi.oimlsmart.org: the same software, booted under the member-state deployment profile.
The TL-only pilot instance at tl.oimlsmart.org: the laboratory posture of the same codebase.
